item.title: About
item.description:
I am an AI professional with extensive experience moving advanced technologies from research into production. Over the years, I have built and led R&D teams, delivered AI systems in demanding environments, and stayed close to the technology while guiding innovation strategies.

My expertise covers applied AI, Voice AI, and modern machine learning methods. I combine hands-on engineering skills with the ability to lead projects that connect research with business needs.
